tool_input.command: hops fg create scaled74313f --version 1 --primary-key row_id --online --features "row_id:string,split:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double" --description "both splits standardized using train-only population mean/std, rounded to 6 decimals" --json 2>&1 | tail -8

mkdir -p .tmp
hops --no-verify -q sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab6706de_featurestore --limit 0 --json "WITH stats AS (SELECT avg(f1) m1, stddev_pop(f1) s1, avg(f2) m2, stddev_pop(f2) s2, avg(f3) m3, stddev_pop(f3) s3, avg(f4) m4, stddev_pop(f4) s4 FROM raw_train74313f_1), allrows AS (SELECT row_id, 'train' AS split, f1, f2, f3, f4 FROM raw_train74313f_1 UNION ALL SELECT row_id, 'serve' AS split, f1, f2, f3, f4 FROM raw_serve74313f_1) SELECT a.row_id, a.split, round((a.f1 - s.m1)/s.s1, 6) AS f1, round((a.f2 - s.m2)/s.s2, 6) AS f2, round((a.f3 - s.m3)/s.s3, 6) AS f3, round((a.f4 - s.m4)/s.s4, 6) AS f4 FROM allrows a CROSS JOIN stats s" > .tmp/scaled.json 2>.tmp/sql.err
echo "exit=$?"; wc -l .tmp/scaled.json; head -c 400 .tmp/scaled.json; echo; echo "---ERR tail---"; tail -3 .tmp/sql.err
